record.field: Sent to a new customer or supplier with the link to the online KYC form.

div.p: Thank you for your interest in working with aHPS.

To register you, please complete our online Know Your Customer (KYC) form. It takes about 10 minutes: company details, your contact persons, invoice and delivery addresses, and a copy of your certificate of incorporation and tax registration.

a.style: background-color: #2F5597; padding: 10px 18px; text-decoration: none; color: #fff; border-radius: 5px; font-size: 14px;

div.p: Once your registration is approved, we will share your customer ID, which appears on all our quotations and invoices.

div.p: Thank you for submitting your registration with aHPS. Before we can approve it, we need the following correction:
Please open your form, update the information or documents, and submit it again. Your previous answers are kept.
